body:
SKETCH v1 is posted as a new comment on STORY-1843 after focused AIDA/relay source review. Design only; no implementation, worktree, status change, or child specs.

Proposed: common-root logical recipient UUID plus atomic handle reservation; one shared send/read/notice resolver; independent delivery receipts; three vertical PRs (managed delivery + compatibility, verified raw-client coverage, relay lifetime/recovery).

Confirmed operator decisions incorporated: launch -n else vendor-role-NN; relay label is the stable handle; invalid explicit names/labels reject with suggested spelling; ended-run unread mail stays with the original run; explicit undelivered notifications go to senders AND advisor; reused labels warn with old unread counts and offer deliberate handover, with explicit headless selection and preserved provenance/history.

Signoff requested on identity/lifecycle/schema, proposed role audience policy (current readers snapshot; zero readers queued for first eligible cohort), migration/old-reader compatibility, namespace/bounds/unlabelled-relay defaults, and Agy capability gate. Actual shipped Agy template currently has only expiry PreInvocation; raw startup and next-turn mail coverage need actual client payload/version proof, not a fabricated Claude SessionStart contract. BUG-2204 current-head verdict checking remains separate.

No naming or relay-mail decision needs to be re-asked. Awaiting advisor signoff before implementation.
subject: SKETCH: STORY-1843 v1
